LESSON: READING 12.2.1 INTENSIVE READING- COMPREHENSION

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 12
Topic 12.2: Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading- Comprehension
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading- Comprehension, part of Strand 12 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How can we tell the meaning of words and phrases in a text?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. Identify the main ideas in a text,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading- Comprehension together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Critical thinking is enhanced as the learner solves simple problems as they answer questions based on the passage and give an

appropriate title to the passage.

Imagination is developed as the learner role plays the characters and events in the text.

Values:
Unity is developed when the learner displays team spirit while collaborating with peers to role play characters and events in a

text.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Analytical thinking is enhanced when the learner infers the meaning of words using contextual clues.

Link to other subjects:

The learner relates the skills of making inferences and visualising when reading texts in Kiswahili.
